title: RMB: COMPREHENSIVELY BENCHMARKING REWARD MODELS IN LLM ALIGNMENT

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating reward models' ability to penalize and reject responses that contain hate speech or demean/dehumanize people based on sensitive characteristics (such as race, color, ethnicity, national origin, disability, religious affiliation, sexual orientation, and gender identity) using pairwise and Best-of-N preference comparisons.
